definitions.explanation: A series of images and sensations during sleep.
A hope or ambition for the future.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨夜|ゆうべ}→ゆうべ：02487_yuube⟧⟦{変|へん}な→変：01124_hen⟧{夢|ゆめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I had a strange dream last night.
I was flying in my dream.
I woke up in the middle of the night after having a scary dream.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧{夢|ゆめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：08388_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{不思議|ふしぎ}に→不思議：02358_fushigi⟧⟦{思|おも}っている→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I've been having the same dream repeatedly since childhood, and I find it mysterious.
My dream is to become a doctor.

examples.japanese: {夢|ゆめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{諦|あきら}めないで→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't give up on your dream.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{夢|ゆめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧⟦{叶|かな}った→叶う：05303_kanau⟧。
examples.english: My long-held dream finally came true.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{夢|ゆめ}だった⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できて→できる：00557_dekiru⟧、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{嬉|うれ}しい→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧。
examples.english: I'm very happy that I was able to join the company I'd dreamed of since I was little.

notes:
{夢|ゆめ} has two meanings: dreams during sleep and aspirations/ambitions.

SLEEP DREAMS:
- {夢|ゆめ}を{見|み}る: to have a dream (NOT {夢|ゆめ}がある)
- {悪夢|あくむ}: nightmare
- {夢|ゆめ}の{中|なか}で: in a dream

ASPIRATIONS:
- {夢|ゆめ}がある: to have a dream/goal
- {夢|ゆめ}が{叶|かな}う: dream comes true
- {夢|ゆめ}を{諦|あきら}める: to give up on a dream
- {夢|ゆめ}を{追|お}いかける: to chase a dream

COMPOUNDS:
- {夢中|むちゅう}: absorbed, engrossed
- {白昼夢|はくちゅうむ}: daydream
- {初夢|はつゆめ}: first dream of the new year

IDIOM:
{夢|ゆめ}のよう: dreamlike, too good to be true
